description.value:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Radius @Template[burst|distance:15]

This grenade is constantly changing, appearing as different colors, materials, and sizes. When detonated, it taps into another plane or reality. Roll a d20 to determine the effect, and use your class DC if the effect calls for a saving throw.

REALITY SPLICING GRENADE EFFECTS

Result

Effect

1

Each creature in the blast radius switches positions with another randomly determined creature in the blast radius (no save).

2

The area is cloaked in magical darkness that darkvision doesn't penetrate for 1 minute.

3

The blast radius becomes an area of zero gravity for [[/gmr 2d4 #rounds]]{2d4 rounds}.

4

Each creature in the blast radius is affected by a 1st-rank wisp ally spell for 1 round.

5

Each creature in the blast radius is affected by a 2nd-rank invisibility spell.

6

Creatures in the blast radius are affected as if by a 3rd-rank fireball spell.

8

About 5,000 harmless, beautiful flying insects appear within the blast radius, granting everyone in the area concealment for [[/gmr 2d4 #rounds]]{2d4 rounds}.

9

Radiation fills the area. Creatures in the area are exposed to severe radiation sickness with a Fortitude DC equal to your class DC.

10

The blast radius becomes an area of high gravity for [[/gmr 2d4 #rounds]]{2d4 rounds}.

11

The blast radius fills with a windstorm dealing @Damage[8d8[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:class|basic] save).

12

A laser light show begins. Each creature in the blast radius must succeed at a @Check[reflex|against:class] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Blinded] for 1 round.

13

Relaxing music fills the area. Each creature in the blast radius gains 10 temporary Hit Points for 1 round.

14

Loud screeching noises burst forth, dealing @Damage[8d8[sonic]] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:class|basic] save).

15

The blast radius becomes the area of a 6th-rank pocket vacuum spell for 1 round.

16

Each creature in the blast radius changes color to a random neon hue for 24 hours.

17

Ghosts fill the area, floating through everyone present. Creatures in the blast radius take @Damage[8d8[void]] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:class|basic] save).

18

Dozens of adorable, harmless Tiny animals appear in the blast radius, covering the ground. This horde makes the blast radius difficult terrain for 5 rounds.

19

The blast radius becomes the area of a 6th-rank corrosive haze spell for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

20

Roll twice more on this table and choose one effect to happen.
